scripts.dev: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces foreach --all --parallel --interlaced --jobs unlimited --include '@saas/api' --include '@saas/web' run dev
scripts.lint: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces foreach --all --include '@saas/*' run lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces foreach --all --include '@saas/*' run typecheck
scripts.test: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces foreach --all --include '@saas/*' run test
scripts.test:integration: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @saas/api run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @saas/web run test:e2e
